body:
> Background:  task:91096b01c6786f30 made the chosen version reach every manifest and lock file, and it is complete. It did not cover the fixed file names in the desktop build recipe: those still say 0.1.0, so after a 0.1.1 build the release step cannot find the new bundles and the build fails.

This task:
On the Delivery page, choosing a new valid version and starting a build succeeds; the release that results records the built desktop files under that version's names. Setting 0.1.1 is the case that fails today.

A version the page refuses, because it is not semver or already has a release, still starts no build and shows the reason.

Done when: in Solace's own workspace, setting 0.1.1 and building finishes passed, and the release lists the desktop bundle files named for 0.1.1.
title: build: release finds chosen version
